spec_citations.divergence: ROUND 1 (now fixed): deliver_stage never received the stamped payload, so the release path staged the generator's UNSTAMPED bytes while result.stamped listed all five markdown documents. The headline deliverable was silently absent and the run reported success. Fixed by extracting write_back() and passing payload to both deliveries; pinned by test_the_staged_bytes_are_the_STAMPED_ones, which reads the git INDEX rather than a return value and was verified non-vacuous by the reviewer.
